import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 10,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.figsize": (26, 16),
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.spines.bottom": False,
    "axes.spines.left": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.major.size": 0,
    "ytick.major.size": 0,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.2,
})

C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text_s": "#555555",
    "steel": "#4e79a7",
    "tangerine": "#f28e2b",
    "coral": "#e15759",
    "sage": "#76b7b2",
    "gray": "#7a7a7a",
    "flow_produce": "#999999",
    "flow_consume": "#b0b0b0",
    "flow_dlq": "#e15759",
    "flow_schema": "#76b7b2",
    "flow_monitor": "#f28e2b",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
}

# ── Node positions (x, y) ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry — top center
sr = (13, 14.8)

# Microservices — left column (producers)
svc_order     = (1.8, 13.0)
svc_payment   = (1.8, 10.5)
svc_inventory = (1.8, 8.0)

# Kafka topics — center hub, left column
kt_orders_created     = (8.0, 13.0)
kt_orders_updated     = (8.0, 11.8)
kt_payments_completed = (8.0, 10.2)
kt_payments_failed    = (8.0, 8.7)

# Kafka topics — center hub, right column
kt_inventory_reserved  = (12.5, 11.2)
kt_inventory_released  = (12.5, 9.7)
kt_shipping_dispatched = (12.5, 7.8)

# DLQ topics — below Kafka hub
dlq_payments     = (8.5, 4.8)
dlq_inventory    = (11.2, 4.8)
dlq_shipping     = (13.9, 4.8)
dlq_notification = (16.6, 4.8)

# Services — right column (consumers)
svc_shipping     = (22.0, 12.0)
svc_notification = (22.0, 10.0)
svc_analytics    = (22.0, 7.5)

# Monitoring chain — bottom row
prometheus   = (13, 2.2)
grafana      = (6, 0.6)
alertmanager = (16, 0.6)
pagerduty    = (13, -0.9)
slack        = (19, -0.9)

# Metric bus — vertical line services connect to
bus_x = 1.8

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, xy, label, subtitle, color, width=2.8, height=0.85,
              fontsize=9, subsize=7, text_color="#111", node_alpha=0.92):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=node_alpha, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.14, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)
        ax.text(x, y - 0.20, subtitle, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=subsize, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)

def draw_topic_node(ax, xy, label, specs, color="#7a7a7a", width=2.7, height=0.72):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.16, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.55, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y + 0.12, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color="#333333", zorder=4)
    ax.text(x, y - 0.18, specs, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=6.2, color="#666666", zorder=4)

def draw_dlq_node(ax, xy, label, width=2.1, height=0.62):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.13, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=C["coral"], linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.65, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7.2, fontweight="bold", color=C["coral"], zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color="#999999", lw=0.6, alpha=0.5,
               style="solid", rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    ax.annotate("", xy=dst, xytext=src,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=lw,
                                alpha=alpha, ls=style,
                                connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}"),
                zorder=zorder)

def draw_bidirectional(ax, p1, p2, color=C["flow_schema"], lw=0.6, alpha=0.35, zorder=1):
    ax.plot([p1[0], p2[0]], [p1[1], p2[1]], color=color, lw=lw,
            alpha=alpha, ls=(0, (2, 3)), zorder=zorder)

# ── Create figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(26, 16))
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 24.5)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 16.2)
ax.set_aspect("auto")
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

# ── Draw region backgrounds (zorder=0, behind everything) ───────────
# Left: Producers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.2, 7.2), 4.0, 6.5,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(2.2, 13.85, "Producer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Center: Kafka hub region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((6.2, 7.0), 8.0, 6.8,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor="#cccccc", edgecolor="#bbbbbb",
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.1, zorder=0))
ax.text(10.2, 13.85, "Kafka Topic Routing Layer",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color="#555555", alpha=0.55, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Right: Consumers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((20.3, 6.8), 4.0, 6.0,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(22.3, 13.05, "Consumer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# DLQ region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((7.0, 4.0), 11.0, 1.65,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor=C["coral"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 5.55, "Dead Letter Queues",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["coral"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Monitoring region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((3.5, -1.5), 18.0, 4.3,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=C["tangerine"], edgecolor=C["tangerine"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 3.0, "Observability Pipeline · Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["tangerine"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# ── Draw Schema Registry connections (dotted, bidirectional) ────────
schema_services = [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory,
                   svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]
for svc in schema_services:
    draw_bidirectional(ax, svc, sr)

# ── Draw produce flows: service → topic ────────────────────────────
produce_pairs = [
    (svc_order, kt_orders_created),
    (svc_order, kt_orders_updated),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_completed),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_failed),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_reserved),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_released),
    (svc_shipping, kt_shipping_dispatched),
]
for src, dst in produce_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_produce"], lw=0.7, alpha=0.45, rad=0.05)

# ── Draw consume flows: topic → service ────────────────────────────
consume_pairs = [
    (kt_orders_created, svc_payment),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_inventory),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_notification),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_analytics),
    (kt_orders_updated, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_shipping),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_inventory),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_shipping),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_released, svc_analytics),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_notification),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_analytics),
]
for src, dst in consume_pairs:
    rad_val = 0.03 if src[0] < dst[0] else -0.03
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_consume"], lw=0.5, alpha=0.40, rad=rad_val)

# ── Draw DLQ flows (red, dashed) ────────────────────────────────────
dlq_pairs = [
    (svc_payment, dlq_payments),
    (svc_inventory, dlq_inventory),
    (svc_shipping, dlq_shipping),
    (svc_notification, dlq_notification),
]
for src, dst in dlq_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_dlq"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6, style="dashed")

# Retry indicators — curved arrows back from DLQ toward origin
for i, (src, dst) in enumerate(dlq_pairs):
    mx, my = (src[0] + dst[0]) / 2 + 0.05, (src[1] + dst[1]) / 2
    ax.plot(mx - 0.35, my - 0.2, marker=r'$\circlearrowleft$',
            color=C["coral"], markersize=11, alpha=0.45, zorder=5)
    # Retry strategy label near DLQ
    strategies = {
        "svc_payment": "exp-backoff\nmax 5 retries",
        "svc_inventory": "fixed-interval\nmax 3 retries",
        "svc_shipping": "exp-backoff\nmax 4 retries",
        "svc_notification": "fixed-interval\nmax 2 retries",
    }
    sid = ["svc_payment", "svc_inventory", "svc_shipping", "svc_notification"][i]
    ax.text(mx + 0.35, my - 0.35, strategies[sid], fontsize=5.5, color=C["coral"],
            ha="center", alpha=0.55, style="italic", zorder=5)

# ── Draw monitoring connections ─────────────────────────────────────
# Metric collection bus: a faint vertical line services tap into
bus_top = 13.5
bus_bottom = prometheus[1]
ax.plot([bus_x, bus_x], [bus_bottom, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=1.0, alpha=0.2, ls=(0, (3, 2)), zorder=0)

# Services → metric bus (tiny horizontal stubs)
for svc in [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] + 1.2, bus_x], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
for svc in [svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 1.4, svc[0] - 0.2], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 0.2, bus_x], [svc[1], bus_x], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

# Schema Registry → bus
ax.plot([sr[0], bus_x], [sr[1], bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Kafka cluster → bus
ax.plot([10.2, bus_x], [7.5, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Bus → Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, (bus_x, bus_bottom + 0.6), prometheus, color=C["tangerine"],
           lw=0.8, alpha=0.4, rad=-0.1)

# Prometheus → Grafana & Alertmanager
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, grafana, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=0.08)
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, alertmanager, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=-0.08)

# Alertmanager → PagerDuty & Slack
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, pagerduty, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, slack, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)

# ── Draw nodes (on top of connections) ──────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry
draw_node(ax, sr, "Schema Registry", "Avro · Compatibility · Governance",
          color=C["sage"], width=3.6, height=0.9, fontsize=10, subsize=7.5,
          text_color="#1a4a47")

# Microservices — left
draw_node(ax, svc_order, "Order Service", "Producer · order-management",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.65, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_payment, "Payment Service", "Producer-Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_inventory, "Inventory Service", "Producer-Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.1, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Microservices — right
draw_node(ax, svc_shipping, "Shipping Service", "Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.75, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_notification, "Notification Service", "Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_analytics, "Analytics Service", "Consumer · best-effort (no DLQ)",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Kafka topics
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_created, "orders.created", "P:12 R:3 · 5K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_updated, "orders.updated", "P:6 R:3 · 3K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_completed, "payments.completed", "P:12 R:3 · 4K/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_failed, "payments.failed", "P:6 R:3 · 800/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_reserved, "inventory.reserved", "P:8 R:3 · 4.5K/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_released, "inventory.released", "P:4 R:3 · 600/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_shipping_dispatched, "shipping.dispatched", "P:8 R:3 · 2K/s · 168h")

# DLQ topics
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_payments, "dlq.payments")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_inventory, "dlq.inventory")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_shipping, "dlq.shipping")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_notification, "dlq.notification")

# Monitoring nodes
mon_style = {"color": C["tangerine"], "fontsize": 8.5, "subsize": 6.5,
             "text_color": "#ffffff", "node_alpha": 0.92}
draw_node(ax, prometheus, "Prometheus", "Scraping · 10–30s interval",
          width=3.2, height=0.75, **mon_style)
draw_node(ax, grafana, "Grafana", "EDA Dashboard",
          width=2.3, height=0.65, color=C["tangerine"], fontsize=8, subsize=6,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, alertmanager, "Alertmanager", "Alert Routing",
          width=2.3, height=0.65, color=C["tangerine"], fontsize=8, subsize=6,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, pagerduty, "PagerDuty", "Critical Alerts",
          width=1.9, height=0.55, color=C["coral"], fontsize=7, subsize=0,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, slack, "Slack", "Warning Alerts",
          width=1.9, height=0.55, color="#e8a838", fontsize=7, subsize=0,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)

# ── Legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_y = 15.9
leg_items = [
    (C["flow_produce"], "solid", 1.8, "Produce (Avro)"),
    (C["flow_consume"], "solid", 1.2, "Consume"),
    (C["flow_dlq"], "dashed", 2.0, "DLQ / Error path"),
    (C["flow_schema"], "dotted", 2.0, "Schema lookup"),
    (C["flow_monitor"], "solid", 1.2, "Metrics / Alert"),
]
x_start = 0.8
for i, (color, ls, lw, label) in enumerate(leg_items):
    cx = x_start + i * 4.5
    ax.plot([cx, cx + 1.2], [legend_y, legend_y], color=color, ls=ls, lw=lw, alpha=0.65)
    ax.text(cx + 1.4, legend_y, label, fontsize=8, color="#555555", va="center")

# ── Title block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.985, "Event-Driven Microservice Architecture: Kafka-Centric Message Flow",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color=C["text"])
fig.text(0.5, 0.96, "6 services · 11 Kafka topics · 4 Dead Letter Queues · Avro serialization · Schema Registry validation · Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager observability",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=11, color=C["text_s"], style="italic")

# ── Flow annotations ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(17.5, 4.25, "max-retries\n exceeded", fontsize=6, color=C["coral"],
        ha="center", alpha=0.6, style="italic")
ax.text(6.0, 14.5, "schema\nlookup", fontsize=6.5, color=C["sage"], ha="center", alpha=0.45)

# ── Alert labels near Alertmanager ──────────────────────────────────
alertmanager_x, alertmanager_y = alertmanager
alert_labels = [
    ("consumer_lag_critical", "dlq_message_rate_high", "service_health_down"),
]
ax.text(alertmanager_x + 1.6, alertmanager_y + 0.3,
        "Alert rules:\n· consumer_lag_critical\n· dlq_message_rate_high\n· service_health_down",
        fontsize=5.8, color=C["tangerine"], ha="left", va="top", alpha=0.55, zorder=5)

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150, facecolor="#fffff8", edgecolor="none")
plt.close()
print("Done: /app/output/result.png")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 10,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.figsize": (26, 16),
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.spines.bottom": False,
    "axes.spines.left": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.major.size": 0,
    "ytick.major.size": 0,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.2,
})

C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text_s": "#555555",
    "steel": "#4e79a7",
    "tangerine": "#f28e2b",
    "coral": "#e15759",
    "sage": "#76b7b2",
    "gray": "#7a7a7a",
    "flow_produce": "#999999",
    "flow_consume": "#b0b0b0",
    "flow_dlq": "#e15759",
    "flow_schema": "#76b7b2",
    "flow_monitor": "#f28e2b",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
}

# ── Node positions (x, y) ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry — top center
sr = (13, 14.8)

# Microservices — left column (producers)
svc_order     = (1.8, 13.0)
svc_payment   = (1.8, 10.5)
svc_inventory = (1.8, 8.0)

# Kafka topics — center hub, left column
kt_orders_created     = (8.0, 13.0)
kt_orders_updated     = (8.0, 11.8)
kt_payments_completed = (8.0, 10.2)
kt_payments_failed    = (8.0, 8.7)

# Kafka topics — center hub, right column
kt_inventory_reserved  = (12.5, 11.2)
kt_inventory_released  = (12.5, 9.7)
kt_shipping_dispatched = (12.5, 7.8)

# DLQ topics — below Kafka hub
dlq_payments     = (8.5, 4.8)
dlq_inventory    = (11.2, 4.8)
dlq_shipping     = (13.9, 4.8)
dlq_notification = (16.6, 4.8)

# Services — right column (consumers)
svc_shipping     = (22.0, 12.0)
svc_notification = (22.0, 10.0)
svc_analytics    = (22.0, 7.5)

# Monitoring chain — bottom row
prometheus   = (13, 2.2)
grafana      = (6, 0.6)
alertmanager = (16, 0.6)
pagerduty    = (13, -0.9)
slack        = (19, -0.9)

# Metric bus — vertical line services connect to
bus_x = 1.8

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, xy, label, subtitle, color, width=2.8, height=0.85,
              fontsize=9, subsize=7, text_color="#111", node_alpha=0.92):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=node_alpha, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.14, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)
        ax.text(x, y - 0.20, subtitle, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=subsize, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)

def draw_topic_node(ax, xy, label, specs, color="#7a7a7a", width=2.7, height=0.72):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.16, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.55, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y + 0.12, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color="#333333", zorder=4)
    ax.text(x, y - 0.18, specs, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=6.2, color="#666666", zorder=4)

def draw_dlq_node(ax, xy, label, width=2.1, height=0.62):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.13, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=C["coral"], linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.65, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7.2, fontweight="bold", color=C["coral"], zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color="#999999", lw=0.6, alpha=0.5,
               style="solid", rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    ax.annotate("", xy=dst, xytext=src,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=lw,
                                alpha=alpha, ls=style,
                                connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}"),
                zorder=zorder)

def draw_bidirectional(ax, p1, p2, color=C["flow_schema"], lw=0.6, alpha=0.35, zorder=1):
    ax.plot([p1[0], p2[0]], [p1[1], p2[1]], color=color, lw=lw,
            alpha=alpha, ls=(0, (2, 3)), zorder=zorder)

# ── Create figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(26, 16))
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 24.5)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 16.2)
ax.set_aspect("auto")
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

# ── Draw region backgrounds (zorder=0, behind everything) ───────────
# Left: Producers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.2, 7.2), 4.0, 6.5,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(2.2, 13.85, "Producer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Center: Kafka hub region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((6.2, 7.0), 8.0, 6.8,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor="#cccccc", edgecolor="#bbbbbb",
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.1, zorder=0))
ax.text(10.2, 13.85, "Kafka Topic Routing Layer",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color="#555555", alpha=0.55, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Right: Consumers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((20.3, 6.8), 4.0, 6.0,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(22.3, 13.05, "Consumer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# DLQ region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((7.0, 4.0), 11.0, 1.65,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor=C["coral"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 5.55, "Dead Letter Queues",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["coral"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Monitoring region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((3.5, -1.5), 18.0, 4.3,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=C["tangerine"], edgecolor=C["tangerine"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 3.0, "Observability Pipeline · Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["tangerine"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# ── Draw Schema Registry connections (dotted, bidirectional) ────────
schema_services = [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory,
                   svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]
for svc in schema_services:
    draw_bidirectional(ax, svc, sr)

# ── Draw produce flows: service → topic ────────────────────────────
produce_pairs = [
    (svc_order, kt_orders_created),
    (svc_order, kt_orders_updated),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_completed),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_failed),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_reserved),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_released),
    (svc_shipping, kt_shipping_dispatched),
]
for src, dst in produce_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_produce"], lw=0.7, alpha=0.45, rad=0.05)

# ── Draw consume flows: topic → service ────────────────────────────
consume_pairs = [
    (kt_orders_created, svc_payment),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_inventory),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_notification),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_analytics),
    (kt_orders_updated, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_shipping),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_inventory),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_shipping),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_released, svc_analytics),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_notification),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_analytics),
]
for src, dst in consume_pairs:
    rad_val = 0.03 if src[0] < dst[0] else -0.03
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_consume"], lw=0.5, alpha=0.40, rad=rad_val)

# ── Draw DLQ flows (red, dashed) ────────────────────────────────────
dlq_pairs = [
    (svc_payment, dlq_payments),
    (svc_inventory, dlq_inventory),
    (svc_shipping, dlq_shipping),
    (svc_notification, dlq_notification),
]
for src, dst in dlq_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_dlq"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6, style="dashed")

# Retry indicators — curved arrows back from DLQ toward origin
for i, (src, dst) in enumerate(dlq_pairs):
    mx, my = (src[0] + dst[0]) / 2 + 0.05, (src[1] + dst[1]) / 2
    ax.plot(mx - 0.35, my - 0.2, marker=r'$\circlearrowleft$',
            color=C["coral"], markersize=11, alpha=0.45, zorder=5)
    # Retry strategy label near DLQ
    strategies = {
        "svc_payment": "exp-backoff\nmax 5 retries",
        "svc_inventory": "fixed-interval\nmax 3 retries",
        "svc_shipping": "exp-backoff\nmax 4 retries",
        "svc_notification": "fixed-interval\nmax 2 retries",
    }
    sid = ["svc_payment", "svc_inventory", "svc_shipping", "svc_notification"][i]
    ax.text(mx + 0.35, my - 0.35, strategies[sid], fontsize=5.5, color=C["coral"],
            ha="center", alpha=0.55, style="italic", zorder=5)

# ── Draw monitoring connections ─────────────────────────────────────
# Metric collection bus: a faint vertical line services tap into
bus_top = 13.5
bus_bottom = prometheus[1]
ax.plot([bus_x, bus_x], [bus_bottom, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=1.0, alpha=0.2, ls=(0, (3, 2)), zorder=0)

# Services → metric bus (tiny horizontal stubs)
for svc in [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] + 1.2, bus_x], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
for svc in [svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 1.4, svc[0] - 0.2], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 0.2, bus_x], [svc[1], bus_x], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

# Schema Registry → bus
ax.plot([sr[0], bus_x], [sr[1], bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Kafka cluster → bus
ax.plot([10.2, bus_x], [7.5, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Bus → Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, (bus_x, bus_bottom + 0.6), prometheus, color=C["tangerine"],
           lw=0.8, alpha=0.4, rad=-0.1)

# Prometheus → Grafana & Alertmanager
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, grafana, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=0.08)
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, alertmanager, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=-0.08)

# Alertmanager → PagerDuty & Slack
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, pagerduty, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, slack, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)

# ── Draw nodes (on top of connections) ──────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry
draw_node(ax, sr, "Schema Registry", "Avro · Compatibility · Governance",
          color=C["sage"], width=3.6, height=0.9, fontsize=10, subsize=7.5,
          text_color="#1a4a47")

# Microservices — left
draw_node(ax, svc_order, "Order Service", "Producer · order-management",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.65, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_payment, "Payment Service", "Producer-Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_inventory, "Inventory Service", "Producer-Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.1, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Microservices — right
draw_node(ax, svc_shipping, "Shipping Service", "Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.75, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_notification, "Notification Service", "Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_analytics, "Analytics Service", "Consumer · best-effort (no DLQ)",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Kafka topics
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_created, "orders.created", "P:12 R:3 · 5K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_updated, "orders.updated", "P:6 R:3 · 3K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_completed, "payments.completed", "P:12 R:3 · 4K/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_failed, "payments.failed", "P:6 R:3 · 800/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_reserved, "inventory.reserved", "P:8 R:3 · 4.5K/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_released, "inventory.released", "P:4 R:3 · 600/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_shipping_dispatched, "shipping.dispatched", "P:8 R:3 · 2K/s · 168h")

# DLQ topics
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_payments, "dlq.payments")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_inventory, "dlq.inventory")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_shipping, "dlq.shipping")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_notification, "dlq.notification")

# Monitoring nodes
mon_style = {"color": C["tangerine"], "fontsize": 8.5, "subsize": 6.5,
             "text_color": "#ffffff", "node_alpha": 0.92}
draw_node(ax, prometheus, "Prometheus", "Scraping · 10–30s interval",
          width=3.2, height=0.75, **mon_style)
draw_node(ax, grafana, "Grafana", "EDA Dashboard",
          width=2.3, height=0.65, color=C["tangerine"], fontsize=8, subsize=6,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, alertmanager, "Alertmanager", "Alert Routing",
          width=2.3, height=0.65, color=C["tangerine"], fontsize=8, subsize=6,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, pagerduty, "PagerDuty", "Critical Alerts",
          width=1.9, height=0.55, color=C["coral"], fontsize=7, subsize=0,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, slack, "Slack", "Warning Alerts",
          width=1.9, height=0.55, color="#e8a838", fontsize=7, subsize=0,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)

# ── Legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_y = 15.9
leg_items = [
    (C["flow_produce"], "solid", 1.8, "Produce (Avro)"),
    (C["flow_consume"], "solid", 1.2, "Consume"),
    (C["flow_dlq"], "dashed", 2.0, "DLQ / Error path"),
    (C["flow_schema"], "dotted", 2.0, "Schema lookup"),
    (C["flow_monitor"], "solid", 1.2, "Metrics / Alert"),
]
x_start = 0.8
for i, (color, ls, lw, label) in enumerate(leg_items):
    cx = x_start + i * 4.5
    ax.plot([cx, cx + 1.2], [legend_y, legend_y], color=color, ls=ls, lw=lw, alpha=0.65)
    ax.text(cx + 1.4, legend_y, label, fontsize=8, color="#555555", va="center")

# ── Title block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color=C["text"])

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte rcParams ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 10,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.figsize": (26, 16),
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.spines.bottom": False,
    "axes.spines.left": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.major.size": 0,
    "ytick.major.size": 0,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.2,
})

C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text_s": "#555555",
    "steel": "#4e79a7",
    "tangerine": "#f28e2b",
    "coral": "#e15759",
    "sage": "#76b7b2",
    "gray": "#7a7a7a",
    "flow_produce": "#999999",
    "flow_consume": "#b0b0b0",
    "flow_dlq": "#e15759",
    "flow_schema": "#76b7b2",
    "flow_monitor": "#f28e2b",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
}

# ── Node positions (x, y) ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry — top center
sr = (13, 14.8)

# Microservices — left column (producers)
svc_order     = (1.8, 13.0)
svc_payment   = (1.8, 10.5)
svc_inventory = (1.8, 8.0)

# Kafka topics — center hub, left column
kt_orders_created     = (8.0, 13.0)
kt_orders_updated     = (8.0, 11.8)
kt_payments_completed = (8.0, 10.2)
kt_payments_failed    = (8.0, 8.7)

# Kafka topics — center hub, right column
kt_inventory_reserved  = (12.5, 11.2)
kt_inventory_released  = (12.5, 9.7)
kt_shipping_dispatched = (12.5, 7.8)

# DLQ topics — below Kafka hub
dlq_payments     = (8.5, 4.8)
dlq_inventory    = (11.2, 4.8)
dlq_shipping     = (13.9, 4.8)
dlq_notification = (16.6, 4.8)

# Services — right column (consumers)
svc_shipping     = (22.0, 12.0)
svc_notification = (22.0, 10.0)
svc_analytics    = (22.0, 7.5)

# Monitoring chain — bottom row
prometheus   = (13, 2.2)
grafana      = (6, 0.6)
alertmanager = (16, 0.6)
pagerduty    = (13, -0.9)
slack        = (19, -0.9)

# Metric bus — vertical line services connect to
bus_x = 1.8

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, xy, label, subtitle, color, width=2.8, height=0.85,
              fontsize=9, subsize=7, text_color="#111", node_alpha=0.92):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=node_alpha, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    if subtitle:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.14, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)
        ax.text(x, y - 0.20, subtitle, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=subsize, color=text_color, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold", color=text_color, zorder=4)

def draw_topic_node(ax, xy, label, specs, color="#7a7a7a", width=2.7, height=0.72):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.16, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.55, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y + 0.12, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color="#333333", zorder=4)
    ax.text(x, y - 0.18, specs, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=6.2, color="#666666", zorder=4)

def draw_dlq_node(ax, xy, label, width=2.1, height=0.62):
    x, y = xy
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.13, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    border = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - width / 2, y - height / 2), width, height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=C["coral"], linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.65, zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border)
    ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7.2, fontweight="bold", color=C["coral"], zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color="#999999", lw=0.6, alpha=0.5,
               style="solid", rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    ax.annotate("", xy=dst, xytext=src,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=lw,
                                alpha=alpha, ls=style,
                                connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}"),
                zorder=zorder)

def draw_bidirectional(ax, p1, p2, color=C["flow_schema"], lw=0.6, alpha=0.35, zorder=1):
    ax.plot([p1[0], p2[0]], [p1[1], p2[1]], color=color, lw=lw,
            alpha=alpha, ls=(0, (2, 3)), zorder=zorder)

# ── Create figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(26, 16))
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 24.5)
ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 16.2)
ax.set_aspect("auto")
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

# ── Draw region backgrounds (zorder=0, behind everything) ───────────
# Left: Producers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.2, 7.2), 4.0, 6.5,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(2.2, 13.85, "Producer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Center: Kafka hub region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((6.2, 7.0), 8.0, 6.8,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor="#cccccc", edgecolor="#bbbbbb",
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.1, zorder=0))
ax.text(10.2, 13.85, "Kafka Topic Routing Layer",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color="#555555", alpha=0.55, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Right: Consumers region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((20.3, 6.8), 4.0, 6.0,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", facecolor=C["steel"], edgecolor="none",
    alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(22.3, 13.05, "Consumer\nServices", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["steel"], alpha=0.4, zorder=1, style="italic")

# DLQ region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((7.0, 4.0), 11.0, 1.65,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor=C["coral"], edgecolor=C["coral"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 5.55, "Dead Letter Queues",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["coral"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# Monitoring region
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((3.5, -1.5), 18.0, 4.3,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.1", facecolor=C["tangerine"], edgecolor=C["tangerine"],
    linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.05, zorder=0))
ax.text(12.5, 3.0, "Observability Pipeline · Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=C["tangerine"], alpha=0.45, zorder=1, style="italic")

# ── Draw Schema Registry connections (dotted, bidirectional) ────────
schema_services = [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory,
                   svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]
for svc in schema_services:
    draw_bidirectional(ax, svc, sr)

# ── Draw produce flows: service → topic ────────────────────────────
produce_pairs = [
    (svc_order, kt_orders_created),
    (svc_order, kt_orders_updated),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_completed),
    (svc_payment, kt_payments_failed),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_reserved),
    (svc_inventory, kt_inventory_released),
    (svc_shipping, kt_shipping_dispatched),
]
for src, dst in produce_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_produce"], lw=0.7, alpha=0.45, rad=0.05)

# ── Draw consume flows: topic → service ────────────────────────────
consume_pairs = [
    (kt_orders_created, svc_payment),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_inventory),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_notification),
    (kt_orders_created, svc_analytics),
    (kt_orders_updated, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_shipping),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_completed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_inventory),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_notification),
    (kt_payments_failed, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_shipping),
    (kt_inventory_reserved, svc_analytics),
    (kt_inventory_released, svc_analytics),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_notification),
    (kt_shipping_dispatched, svc_analytics),
]
for src, dst in consume_pairs:
    rad_val = 0.03 if src[0] < dst[0] else -0.03
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_consume"], lw=0.5, alpha=0.40, rad=rad_val)

# ── Draw DLQ flows (red, dashed) ────────────────────────────────────
dlq_pairs = [
    (svc_payment, dlq_payments),
    (svc_inventory, dlq_inventory),
    (svc_shipping, dlq_shipping),
    (svc_notification, dlq_notification),
]
for src, dst in dlq_pairs:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, dst, color=C["flow_dlq"], lw=1.2, alpha=0.6, style="dashed")

# Retry indicators — curved arrows back from DLQ toward origin
for i, (src, dst) in enumerate(dlq_pairs):
    mx, my = (src[0] + dst[0]) / 2 + 0.05, (src[1] + dst[1]) / 2
    ax.plot(mx - 0.35, my - 0.2, marker=r'$\circlearrowleft$',
            color=C["coral"], markersize=11, alpha=0.45, zorder=5)
    # Retry strategy label near DLQ
    strategies = {
        "svc_payment": "exp-backoff\nmax 5 retries",
        "svc_inventory": "fixed-interval\nmax 3 retries",
        "svc_shipping": "exp-backoff\nmax 4 retries",
        "svc_notification": "fixed-interval\nmax 2 retries",
    }
    sid = ["svc_payment", "svc_inventory", "svc_shipping", "svc_notification"][i]
    ax.text(mx + 0.35, my - 0.35, strategies[sid], fontsize=5.5, color=C["coral"],
            ha="center", alpha=0.55, style="italic", zorder=5)

# ── Draw monitoring connections ─────────────────────────────────────
# Metric collection bus: a faint vertical line services tap into
bus_top = 13.5
bus_bottom = prometheus[1]
ax.plot([bus_x, bus_x], [bus_bottom, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=1.0, alpha=0.2, ls=(0, (3, 2)), zorder=0)

# Services → metric bus (tiny horizontal stubs)
for svc in [svc_order, svc_payment, svc_inventory]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] + 1.2, bus_x], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
for svc in [svc_shipping, svc_notification, svc_analytics]:
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 1.4, svc[0] - 0.2], [svc[1], svc[1]], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
    ax.plot([svc[0] - 0.2, bus_x], [svc[1], bus_x], color=C["tangerine"],
            lw=0.35, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

# Schema Registry → bus
ax.plot([sr[0], bus_x], [sr[1], bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Kafka cluster → bus
ax.plot([10.2, bus_x], [7.5, bus_top], color=C["tangerine"],
        lw=0.35, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

# Bus → Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, (bus_x, bus_bottom + 0.6), prometheus, color=C["tangerine"],
           lw=0.8, alpha=0.4, rad=-0.1)

# Prometheus → Grafana & Alertmanager
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, grafana, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=0.08)
draw_arrow(ax, prometheus, alertmanager, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=-0.08)

# Alertmanager → PagerDuty & Slack
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, pagerduty, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)
draw_arrow(ax, alertmanager, slack, color=C["tangerine"], lw=0.9, alpha=0.55)

# ── Draw nodes (on top of connections) ──────────────────────────────
# Schema Registry
draw_node(ax, sr, "Schema Registry", "Avro · Compatibility · Governance",
          color=C["sage"], width=3.6, height=0.9, fontsize=10, subsize=7.5,
          text_color="#1a4a47")

# Microservices — left
draw_node(ax, svc_order, "Order Service", "Producer · order-management",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.65, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_payment, "Payment Service", "Producer-Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_inventory, "Inventory Service", "Producer-Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.1, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Microservices — right
draw_node(ax, svc_shipping, "Shipping Service", "Consumer · exp-backoff",
          color=C["steel"], width=2.75, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_notification, "Notification Service", "Consumer · fixed-interval",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")
draw_node(ax, svc_analytics, "Analytics Service", "Consumer · best-effort (no DLQ)",
          color=C["steel"], width=3.0, fontsize=9, subsize=6.5, text_color="#ffffff")

# Kafka topics
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_created, "orders.created", "P:12 R:3 · 5K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_orders_updated, "orders.updated", "P:6 R:3 · 3K/s · 168h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_completed, "payments.completed", "P:12 R:3 · 4K/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_payments_failed, "payments.failed", "P:6 R:3 · 800/s · 336h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_reserved, "inventory.reserved", "P:8 R:3 · 4.5K/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_inventory_released, "inventory.released", "P:4 R:3 · 600/s · 72h")
draw_topic_node(ax, kt_shipping_dispatched, "shipping.dispatched", "P:8 R:3 · 2K/s · 168h")

# DLQ topics
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_payments, "dlq.payments")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_inventory, "dlq.inventory")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_shipping, "dlq.shipping")
draw_dlq_node(ax, dlq_notification, "dlq.notification")

             "text_color": "#ffffff", "node_alpha": 0.92}

          width=3.2, height=0.75, **mon_style)

          width=2.3, height=0.65, color=C["tangerine"], fontsize=8, subsize=6,
          text_color="#ffffff", node_alpha=0.82)
draw_node(ax, alertmanager, "Alertmanager", "Alert Routing",
